request.description: Steady flying loop in place: BOTH wings flap DOWN TOGETHER then return to the reference highest pose, restrained downward arc only. Shoulder joints lead, flight feathers bend naturally with delay. Slight chest/hip breathing and tail feather wave. Rider stays seated and balances, hair follows. No leg-walking, no upward wing swing across rider. Exact approved rider and mount, same costume, colours, face and proportions, facing right, fixed camera. Preserve eyes with coloured iris and white highlight; no black empty eyes. Rider remains seated and hands retain reins or book. Far rider leg stays hidden; near wing stays in FRONT of lower rider hair/body consistently, below the face. Never move a wing across the face. No extra limbs, symbols, background, speed lines, exterior magic or particles. Return seamlessly to reference pose.
